newsitem.title: USA: TriMas sees record results in 1996.
newsitem.headline: TriMas sees record results in 1996.

text.p: TriMas Corp said Monday it expects record sales and earnings in 1996, based on continuing modest economic improvement, ongoing operating efficiencies, market share initiatives and new products.
In 1995, it earned $1.51 a primary share on sales of $553.5 million.
TriMas is a diversified proprietary products company in the commercial, industrial and consumer niche markets.
Earlier, TriMas reported third quarter earnings of $0.39 a primary share, up from $0.36 a year ago. For the first nine months, it earned $1.25 a share, up from $1.17.
TriMas said its towing systems, specialty container products and corporate companies all had record performances in the third quarter and first nine months of the year.

Specialty fasteners' operating performance through the first nine months were hurt by lower sales to the heavy-duty truck market and the home appliance industry and lower demand for specialized metallurgical services.
During both periods, sales of specialty aerospace fasteners increased significantly, reflecting improving conditions in commercial aerospace markets.
